verses: Qasam hai sooraj ki aur uss ki dhoop ki
Qasam hai chand ki jab uss kay peechay aaye
Qasam hai din ki jab sooraj ko numaya keray
Qasam hai raat ki jab ussay dhaanp ley
Qasam hai aasman ki aur uss kay bananey ki
Qasam hai zamin ki aur ussay humwaar kerney ki
Qasam hai nafs ki aur ussay durust bananey ki
Phir samajh di uss ko bad-kaari ki aur bach ker chalney ki
Jiss ney ussay pak kiya woh kaamyaab hua
Aur jiss ney ussay khak mein mila diya woh nakaam hua
(qom) samood ney apni sirkashi kay baees jhutlaya
Jab unn mein ka bara badbakht uth khara hua
Unhen Allah kay rasool ney farma diya tha kay Allah Taalaa ki oontni aur uss kay peenay ki bari ki (hifazat kero)

Unn logon ney apney payghumbar ko jhoota samajh ker uss oontni ki kochen kaat den, pus unn kay rab ney unn kay gunahon kay baees unn per halakat daali aur phir halakat ko aam ker diya aur uss basti ko barabar kerdiya
Woh nahi darta uss kay tabah kun anjam say
